_meta.openai/widgetDescription: This card already shows the user the full document: parties, dates, every line, VAT, totals and status. Reply in one or two sentences. Do not repeat or redraw the document, its lines or its totals, as text or as a table. Still mention any warning or note in the result.

description: Use this when a connected user asks to create a quote, estimate or proforma invoice for a client. Saves a new draft quote (or proforma invoice) for a client of the business. It gets the next quote number. Line descriptions are printed on the tax invoice: write them in English, translating when the user writes in another language (for example "Консультация" becomes "Consultation"). Keep names, brands and model numbers exactly as written. Use another language only when the user explicitly asks for it or quotes the exact text. Lines are priced by Fatura Go as in the app (each line rounded, header = sum of lines; with prices_include_vat the entered price includes VAT, e.g. 26.95 = 25.67 + 1.28 VAT). Returns the stored lines and totals and app_url. Nothing is issued, numbered as a tax invoice or sent: the user reviews and issues it in Fatura Go ("Review and issue in Fatura Go"). valid_until defaults to 30 days from today. Do not use it for an invoice (create_draft_invoice) or to turn a quote into an invoice: that is Convert to invoice in Fatura Go.

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

client_name.description: Only when the client_id is not known: nothing is written, and the matching clients are returned to pick from.

currency.description: One of AED, SAR, USD, EUR, GBP, KWD, QAR, BHD, OMR, INR. Default the client's preferred currency, else the business currency.

document_language_override.description: Language this document prints in: en, ar or bilingual. Left out: a new draft follows the business setting and an update keeps the current choice; null goes back to the business setting. Only for a document the user asked to print in another language.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique string (for example a UUID) for this request: a retry with the same key returns the first result instead of writing again.

items.description: The lines, 1 to 100. On an update they replace every line.

description.description: Line descriptions are printed on the tax invoice: write them in English, translating when the user writes in another language (for example "Консультация" becomes "Consultation"). Keep names, brands and model numbers exactly as written. Use another language only when the user explicitly asks for it or quotes the exact text.

unit_code.description: Unit of measure, one of C62, HUR, DAY, WEE, MON, ANN, KGM, TNE, MTR, KMT, MTK, LTR, XBX, SET, PR, E48, LS (UN/ECE Rec 20/21: C62 each, HUR hour, DAY day, WEE week, MON month, ANN year, KGM kg, TNE tonne, MTR metre, KMT km, MTK m², LTR litre, XBX box, SET set, PR pair, E48 service, LS lump sum). Left out: a new line gets C62 (each); on an update a line keeps its stored unit when it is at the same position with the same description as before, else C62. Send unit_code to change it.

unit_price.description: Price of one unit. VAT-inclusive when prices_include_vat is true, else before VAT.

vat_type.description: One of standard, zero, exempt, out_of_scope. Default standard (5%).

prices_include_vat.description: Whether unit_price includes the 5% VAT. Default the business setting.
